active_outcome: 2: one external validation or paid-pilot conversion
decision: Identify reproducible forecast-error constraints suitable for evaluator-owned prospective review, preserving every original negative gate.
analysis: Run original seven-candidate development selection and six-baseline holdout evaluation unchanged. Retain all development candidates and selected-candidate plus all baseline holdout predictions. Descriptive official-versus-selected overall, all eight authorities and every holdout calendar month: paired MAE, WAPE and nearest-rank p95 absolute error. No model retuning, subset selection or multiplicity-adjusted significance claims from new descriptive tables.
interpretation: The frozen July 2026 holdout has already been inspected. This is a reproduction and diagnostic review, not a new untouched or prospective test.
Original primary metric is seasonal MASE. Supplemental MAE/WAPE/p95 and authority/month deltas are descriptive, not new predeclared superiority gates.
Historical EIA rows may have been revised; pre-origin calendar dates do not establish publication-time availability or an as-issued forecast archive.
Forecast error measured in MWh is not electricity saved, reduced fuel use, avoided outages or economic benefit. There is no accepted buyer cost function, action policy or service-equivalence proof.
No sector-wide dollar extrapolation or aggregation of overlapping opportunities is permitted. Next gate is an independent replay followed by an as-of, buyer-owned prospective test.
All original coverage, baseline-comparison, external-validation and field-validation gates remain unchanged. Numerical improvement alone does not clear promotion.
